name: s81lk_kp4_enc
structural_change: S81-KP4 10-17 STREAMING REWRITE (replaces the 8cd04168b kit whose CTS gate FAILED: 17,084 sinks one root, TT insertion 346.5 ps, setup WNS -503.9 ps through the ph barrel window, ph fanout 6,446, W pins packed in 60 um): the parity LFSR runs on the arriving beats (chunk k = {beat k-1, beat k} at a fixed offset, 10:1 one-hot select with 4 kept select copies, no barrel shifter); the 520-bit window matrix parts are computed and registered a cycle ahead (wb), only A rem (<= 173 inputs) is in the loop; beats wait in a 6-deep delay line and each PMA word is a fixed-offset select over {d5, d4} (17 kept select copies). ~6.4k registers (was 17.1k), regional synchronous reset tree (ot_s81_kp4_rst, control only, no datapath reset). RTL latency port->p_d 7 cycles (was 21: -14 for the link latency model) + 2 pin registers (recipe 4). Outline 194.4 x 194.4 (square); pins spread over the full faces: p_d W (PMA side, 544 in 179 um = 3.0/um), tx_d E (core side), clk / rst_n N centre. Exact vs rs544.py (KP4 bench base PASS 16/16 parity, EMUT1 FAIL).

job.purpose: S81 link KP4 encoder leaf (one per SerDes link macro), streaming rewrite 10-17. Bench = KP4 base (16/16 parity exact vs rs544.py, 122 frames exact, 17 beyond-t flagged, 0 miscorrected) and encoder mutant EMUT1.
